_readme: Course/unit weights control how often real-feel exam questions are drawn from each. Any course_slug or unit key NOT listed here defaults to 1.0 (equal weight). Unit keys are 'course-slug|unit-slug'. These values are volume-corrected: divided by each course's actual question count so the real appearance percentage matches the intended target share (computed from the original 40-80 scale given), not skewed by which course happens to have more generated content. Regenerate with check_weight_balance.py after any major content regeneration, since question counts per course will shift.
